attrs.definition: Silver & Sutton 'Era of Experience': agents learn continually from their own grounded experience streams rather than frozen human-data pretraining. The organizing thesis behind D6.
From-random-init learning vs reusing prior weights/data. Pure tabula-rasa is compute-brutal (~1000+ GPU-days for 50 Atari); reincarnating RL reuses prior computation.
Internally-generated reward driving exploration in the absence of (or to augment) extrinsic reward: curiosity, novelty, empowerment, learning-progress.
Intrinsic reward = prediction error of a learned model (ICM inverse-dynamics features; RND fixed-random-target). Drives exploration of unfamiliar states.
Information-theoretic drive to maximize the agent's control over future states (mutual info between actions and future outcomes).
Reward the IMPROVEMENT in prediction error (not raw error) — fixes the noisy-TV pathology of curiosity/RND.
Auto-generate a sequence of tasks/environments matched to the agent's current frontier so goals stay learnable-but-not-trivial.
Co-evolve a teacher that proposes environments maximizing student regret/learning-potential; yields robust zero-shot transfer.
Select/mutate levels by estimated regret (PLR/PAIRED/ACCEL/SFL), steering toward solvable-but-hard levels and away from trivial/impossible collapse.
Learn moment-by-moment from a single interaction stream with no replay buffer and no target networks (batch-size-one). Closest to OaK's operating regime.
Update (fast) weights at inference per instance/chunk — turns in-context adaptation into real gradient updates; an LLM-native path to run-time learning.
Abandon the objective; reward behavioral novelty alone. Novelty is a proxy for stepping stones toward the objective on deceptive problems.
Compete only against phenotypically-similar peers so locally-optimal but globally-weak individuals survive as stepping stones (NSLC; Dominated Novelty Search).
Sub-optimal intermediate solutions that are building blocks for later breakthroughs; objective-only search fails to reward them, archives preserve them.
A QD archive/repertoire retains diverse high-performers across a behavior space; that retained set IS a preserved gene pool from which latent traits can be recombined — hill-climbing discards it.

Non-expressed (recessive) or non-champion traits held in abeyance can be re-expressed/recombined when useful. Diploid GAs (Goldberg-Smith) give the literal genotypic form; QD archives the scalable form.
Two-allele genome where recessive alleles are a latent memory of past-optimal traits; adaptive dominance re-expresses them in non-stationary environments (Goldberg & Smith 1987).
Recombine genetic material across archive niches: isoline/directional variation, discrete gene-level (meiosis-like) crossover, LLM in-context recombination of many elites.
Sum of fitness over all archive cells — captures quality AND diversity; discarding non-champions directly lowers it. The metric that rewards keeping the whole pool.
Intra-population diversity-maintenance (fitness sharing, crowding, RTS, NEAT species) that protects sub-lineages so specialists survive and premature convergence is avoided.
De-rate an individual's fitness by neighborhood crowding, forcing the population to spread across multiple peaks (Goldberg & Richardson 1987; used within NEAT species).
Partition a behavior space into cells; keep one elite per cell — an archive of specialists by construction (differentiation by behavior-space partition).
Reproduction gated only by a survival threshold (e.g. 'solved a maze'/'was solved once'), with no objective/novelty/descriptor — yet two coupled populations differentiate (MCC).
A system endlessly produces artifacts that are novel (raise uncertainty about the future) AND learnable (improve prediction of the future). Argued essential for ASI.
Accumulated Number of Novel Environments Created and Solved — measures whether open-ended generation keeps innovating or stagnates (encoding-dependent).
Populations (esp. LLM-mutated) converge to structural homogeneity / one champion; the failure mode that gene-pool preservation and speciation exist to prevent.
Two (or more) populations evolve against each other (environments↔agents, tasks↔models), generating auto-curricula and driving differentiation.
Use an LLM to generate variation (and sometimes evaluate) inside an evolutionary/QD loop — sample-efficient and semantically valid, but biased toward low structural diversity.
Score candidates on a sealed/held-out signal computed by deterministic code (not the mutating LLM's self-report), to catch overfitting/measurement-artifact 'improvements'.

attrs.definition: Selectively re-initialize a small fraction of low-utility units each step to inject continual variability; maintains plasticity indefinitely.
Periodically recycle dormant neurons (reinit incoming, zero outgoing) to restore plasticity in deep RL.
Streaming deep RL with NO replay buffer and NO target networks; layer-norm + step-size adaptation + observation/reward scaling overcome the 'stream barrier'.
General model-based RL learning a world model from experience; imagines rollouts; one config across 150+ tasks; single GPU.
2B-param agent that learns a scalable transformer world model from OFFLINE video and does RL-in-imagination; ~21 FPS single GPU.
Decoder-free latent world model + local trajectory optimization; one hyperparameter set across 104 continuous-control tasks.
Intrinsic reward = prediction error of a predictor net vs a fixed random target net; novelty bonus for unfamiliar states.
Curiosity = prediction error in an inverse-dynamics feature space; drives exploration under sparse reward.
RND successor: samples the target from a normal distribution; intrinsic reward bounded by a pseudo-count term for proper exploration decay.
A foundation model writes environment+reward CODE for the next learnable-AND-interesting task; unbounded curriculum via code generation.
Protagonist-Antagonist Induced Regret Environment Design: train a teacher to maximize regret between two students → solvable-but-hard levels.
Regret-based UED with evolution: edit-and-replay high-regret levels for rapid complexity escalation and zero-shot transfer.
Update a subset of fast weights at inference (chunk-wise); a 4B model handles contexts up to 128k — a step toward continual learning in LLMs.
One LLM is both proposer (invents tasks to maximize learning progress) and solver, verified by a code executor; zero external data (but pretrained base).
Discretize a behavior space into cells; keep the single best elite per cell — an illuminating archive of specialists.
CMA-ES self-adaptation driving a MAP-Elites archive; higher quality + broader diversity than CMA-ES or MAP-Elites alone.
Soft-archive annealing fixes CMA-ME's three failure modes (premature exploration, flat objectives, low-res archives).
Combine a novelty objective with local competition so locally-optimal but globally-weak individuals survive as stepping stones — direct QD ancestor.
Local competition as a fitness transform: competition fitness = distance to k-nearest FITTER solutions; niche-champions preserved with no grid/threshold.
Meiosis-like gene-level crossover recombining elite genetic material across archive niches; strongest gains late, once building blocks are established.
Perturb along the line between two archive elites — the workhorse recombination operator exploiting inter-niche (inter-'species') correlation.
LLM reads MANY archive elites as context and recombines them, beyond the usual 1-2-parent recombination — more innovative solutions from the pool.
Two-allele genome where recessive alleles are latent memory of past-optimal traits; adaptive dominance re-expresses them under non-stationarity.
Evolve topology+weights, protecting innovation via speciation (fitness sharing within species); historical markings align crossover.
Coevolve modules + blueprints for deep nets (NEAT for deep architectures).
Black-box ES scaling to 1000+ parallel workers (seeds + scalar returns only), competitive with policy-gradient RL, no backprop.
LLM diff-model as the mutation operator inside MAP-Elites; generated 100k+ working programs in an unseen domain, then bootstrapped a new model.
LLM both generates variation AND judges quality+diversity — extends QD to qualitative domains (creative writing).
LLM-driven program evolution over an ISLAND archive of subpopulations with parent+inspiration sampling, code-novelty rejection, bandit LLM-ensemble; ~150 evals to SoTA.
Distributed QD where heterogeneous LLMs are the mutation operators exchanging best-local solutions ('Digital Red Queen'); model diversity drives QD-score.
Maintains an open-ended ARCHIVE of self-modifying coding agents and breeds from it (not greedy hill-climbing).
Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer: co-generate environments + optimize paired agents; inter-niche TRANSFER finds stepping stones direct optimization cannot.
CPPN-encoded unbounded environments + the ANNECS metric; near-linear (non-plateauing) innovation vs original POET's ~20k-iteration stagnation.
Use a foundation model as a model of human interestingness to prioritize tasks that are learnable AND interesting.
Coevolve mazes + solvers gated only by a minimal survival criterion; differentiation with NO objective/novelty/descriptor. Resource cap prevents collapse.
Coevolve an LLM archive (via model-merge crossover + weight-noise mutation) with a synthetic-task archive → growing set of specialist LLMs with broad coverage.
Open-ended procedurally-generated physics task space (Jax2D) trained with Scheduled Filtered-Learnability UED; general agent beats specialists on holdout.
Foundation models write code to leap across policy-space local optima; QDSP balances quality+diversity to avoid converging to one strategy.

entities.name: Standard deep nets lose plasticity under continual learning (Continual-ImageNet binary tasks drop from ~89% to ~77% ≈ linear-net level by the 2000th task); continual backpropagation (+L2) 'fully overcame' plasticity loss in the Nature setup.
Scale ALONE does not reliably solve plasticity loss in LLMs — it persists across sizes and needs optimization/regularization/weight-management interventions.

Across ~50 mitigation methods, NO single plasticity intervention dominates; general-purpose regularization (e.g. L2, weight-norm) often OUTPERFORMS specialized plasticity methods. Loss of plasticity is mitigated in controlled benchmarks but NOT solved in general.
Streaming deep RL (stream-x) matches the sample efficiency of batch RL with NO replay buffer and NO target networks, using one hyperparameter set; best model-free result on DM-Control Dog.
DreamerV3 is the first algorithm to collect diamonds in Minecraft from scratch (no human data / no curriculum), with one configuration across 150+ tasks, trainable on a single GPU.

Dreamer 4 (2B params) is the first to obtain Minecraft diamonds PURELY from a fixed offline dataset — RL happens inside the learned world model — with real-time interactive inference (~21 FPS) on a single GPU.

Absolute Zero reaches SOTA on coding+math reasoning with ZERO external data via proposer/solver self-play verified by a code executor — but from a PRETRAINED base (zero data, not zero pretraining): a hybrid, not from-random-init.

V-JEPA 2-AC does zero-shot Franka pick-and-place from image goals after post-training on <62h unlabeled robot video — but the >1B encoder is frontier-scale video-PRETRAINED (not from-scratch), the compromise OaK argues against.

Pure tabula-rasa RL is compute-brutal (~1000+ GPU-days for 50 Atari games) and failed at Dota/StarCraft scale without shaping+imitation+curriculum; 'learn from experience' has momentum but 'beat pretrained from random init at scale' is undemonstrated.
RND remains a useful novelty baseline but degrades with a real noisy-TV and suffers detachment/derailment; 2025-26 successors move to learning-progress signals and distributional targets (RDD).
Test-time training (updating weights per test instance) provably reduces the sample size needed for in-context learning, contingent on pretrain↔target alignment.

Diploidy with dominance helps non-stationary optimization because recessive alleles hold past-optimal traits in abeyance as a latent memory, re-expressible when the environment swings back — the literal 'recessive trait recovery' the founder's metaphor names.

A precomputed MAP-Elites behavior-performance repertoire (~13k gaits) lets a damaged robot recover a working gait in <2 minutes / ~a dozen trials (Intelligent Trial & Error) — a preserved archive enabling later recovery of latent capabilities.
Novelty search (abandoning the objective) beats objective-based search on deceptive maze/biped tasks because objectives fail to reward the stepping stones that lead to them.

QD (MAP-Elites) provably outperforms (μ+1)-EA on two NP-hard classes (monotone approximately-submodular maximization under a size constraint; set cover) — the first rigorous runtime proof QD helps optimization.

Discrete gene-level crossover ('mirroring meiosis') recombines elite genetic material across the archive, improving QD-score, coverage, and max-fitness — with strongest gains LATE, once building blocks are established in the archive.
Dominated Novelty Search (local competition as a fitness transform, no grid/bounds/thresholds) significantly beats MAP-Elites (p<1e-3) and Threshold-Elites (p<1e-9) on MuJoCo QD-score and coverage.
Combining a LARGE diversity of archive solutions (not just 1-2 parents) via an LLM in-context generator yields more innovative solutions — recombining latent traits from the whole pool.

The Darwin Gödel Machine's open-ended AGENT ARCHIVE (not greedy hill-climbing) improves SWE-bench 20.0%→50.0% and Polyglot 14.2%→30.7%; ablating open-ended exploration makes it plateau/regress — keeping the diverse archive is causally necessary.

Heterogeneous LLM mutation operators beat single/homogeneous ensembles: a 4-model GPT+Claude ensemble gave +124% merged-archive QD-score (45.90 vs 20.46) and +28% coverage — 'model diversity, not merely parallelism, is the key driver.'

LLM-driven mutation collapses structural diversity: 87% of chains revisited seen forms in >93% of mutations; median ~10 unique structural templates vs ~270 unique programs / 143 skeletons for classical GP subtree mutation — semantic-aware mutation carries a systematic bias toward structural homogeneity.
ShinkaEvolve reaches circle-packing SoTA in ~150 evaluations (vs thousands) via an island archive + code-novelty rejection + bandit LLM-ensemble; strong on AIME-2024 scaffolds and ALE-Bench.

COUNTER: some deceptive problems are solved by objective-only methods WITHOUT explicit diversity maintenance — QD's advantage is problem-dependent, and QD is sometimes benchmarked unfairly against single-objective baselines.

Minimal Criterion Coevolution produces a broad range of specialists (maze topologies + solution trajectories) with NO fitness function, novelty archive, or behavior descriptor — differentiation needs neither an objective nor an explicit diversity pressure, only a survival gate on two coupled populations.
MCC needs a RESOURCE CAP (each problem consumable by a bounded number of solvers) to prevent the 'everyone farms the easiest maze' collapse — the mechanism that keeps differentiation alive.

NEAT speciation (fitness sharing within species) protects topological innovation long enough to optimize, so an initially-weak new structure is not immediately killed by the current champion — the canonical anti-collapse mechanism.

Original POET's ANNECS plateaus after ~20,000 iterations (fixed encoding exhausts obstacle variety) while Enhanced POET's grows near-linearly — open-endedness is REAL but encoding-dependent: a bounded generator stagnates.

Open-endedness — endlessly producing artifacts that are NOVEL (raise future uncertainty) AND LEARNABLE (improve future prediction), observer-relative — is an essential property of any artificial superhuman intelligence.

Dreaming-in-Code (FM writes intermediate environment code to scaffold curricula) gives +16% mean return vs the strongest baseline and non-zero success on late-game combat tasks where prior methods scored 0.

AC/DC coevolves an LLM archive (model-merge crossover + weight-noise mutation) with a task archive, producing specialist LLMs that surpass larger models at LESS GPU memory and with broader capability Coverage, without explicit benchmark optimization.

An open-ended-curriculum general agent (Kinetix + SFL) zero-shot-generalizes to unseen human-designed levels and solves some tasks that SPECIALIST agents could not — open-ended curricula can beat specialists.

An information-theoretic definition (bit-equivalent B_ρ growing linearly, ΩT) critiques novelty+learnability for not indicating capability IMPROVEMENT; classical bandits are provably non-open-ended, infinite-dim linear-Gaussian bandits can be.

Open-endedly EVOLVED networks largely lack the Fractured Entangled Representation that SGD-trained networks exhibit (approaching a unified factored representation); FER may degrade generalization, creativity, and continual learning in large models.

SKEPTIC: an LLM constrained to outputs supported by its training data could never generate truly novel text; hallucination is inevitable (finite information capacity) — FM-driven 'open-endedness' may be bounded by the training distribution unless a generate→train→re-generate loop is closed.

A self-evolving agent HARNESS via Gated Semantic QD — LLM diagnoses failures while deterministic code does all sampling/measurement/stat-testing, archive indexed by (WHERE x WHY) pathology as anti-overfitting bias — gains +9 to +15.5 pp across 7 domains on a SEALED test with 86-147% generalization retention on a frozen open-weight model; the diagnostic/credit methodology transfers across model families.
